bundle.shortDescription: Secure team chat on your own server.
bundle.longDescription: Aulora is a self-hosted team chat client. Message encryption is handled server-side behind an external key manager, so the client holds no keys. The desktop shell adds native menus, a tray, notifications, an unread badge and aulora:// deep links.
